answer: Latent duplicate detection. Each identity carries a random secret seed committed privately at registration; the raven scores pairwise behavioral overlap, and any pair exceeding a similarity threshold is flagged as clones, with both suspended. To appeal, an operator must reveal its seed, letting the lantern test prove independence and unlink from flagged clusters. Attacker cost: forging distinct behavior across N clones, since each clone must sustain extra genuine interactions to clear the timber threshold of separation.
